name: repo-harness-tuner
description: Run evidence-backed Codex harness doctor/loop workflows and generate project team/skill plans.

interface.shortDescription: Generate Codex team/skill plans and improve repo harnesses.
interface.longDescription: Repo Harness Tuner combines a team/skill factory with an adaptive harness engine. The one-command doctor and run-loop inspect, diagnose, design, factory-plan, tune, evaluate, and history-track a repo from a single CLI entry point before any writes happen. The 0.5 factory flow grounds generated roles and skill drafts in concrete repo evidence such as project markers, package scripts, harness files, source markers, validation commands, stale artifacts, conflicts, and installed skill overlaps. The fixture suite adds golden tests across empty, Vite/Node, Unity, Codex plugin, and already-harnessed project shapes so later changes have regression coverage. The factory side designs project-specific Codex agent roles, planned skills, orchestration docs, visible/background worker policies, repo-local team/skill artifacts, copyable Codex SKILL.md drafts, confirmed skill installs, and Codex plugin team presets. The engine side runs analyze, diagnose, design, tune, restructure, evaluate, and history feedback loops for repo-local Codex harness design. It includes codex-harness-setup so one plugin can bootstrap, generate reviewable diffs, tune, review, evaluate, score evaluation results, track history feedback, and manage AGENTS.md, Docs/AI/*, validation guidance, human-involvement policy, Codex worker patterns, target files, and next review triggers as the project evolves.
capabilities: Codex team and skill factory planning
